svg.title: Personal AI OS — the three write lanes
svg.desc: Every write is classified into one of three lanes — ordinary, consequential, or system — each with heavier process. When unsure, pick the heavier lane; never slip a system change into an ordinary task.
svg.text: How much process a write gets — pick the heavier lane when unsure

g.text: triggers: new leaf notes · typos · status flips · adding a link
process: search-before-create → template → mint id → write → validate · one-line report · no journal
triggers: editing canonical · renames · merges · anything with dependents
process: + check relations both ways · four-outcome rule · one journal line
triggers: anything under System/ · schemas · structure · components
process: STOP → developer mode · checkpoint · impact report · human approval · tests

svg.text: Pick the heavier lane when unsure. Never slip a System change into an ordinary task.
